items.title: Meta’s Muse Charm looks like a Tamagotchi, but it’s tapping into a much newer trend
items.summary: Meta’s new AI gadget may look like a Tamagotchi, but its dangling form factor taps into a much broader Gen Z trend around bag charms, retro tech, and turning gadgets into fashion accessories.

items.title: Databricks buys Row Zero and is scouting for more startups to acquire
items.summary: Databricks has brought cloud spreadsheet startup Row Zero, adding yet another acquisition to its 2026 shopping spree.

items.title: Google Photos ‘Clueless’-inspired virtual closet is now available on Android and iOS
items.summary: The AI-powered feature builds a virtual wardrobe from your photos, and is now broadly available after first rolling out to Android users in June.

items.title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Everything you need to know
items.summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit is a full-day gathering in Boston on November 4 where founders across all stages connect with top VCs and experienced entrepreneurs to gain tactical insights on building and scaling their companies.

items.title: 20 minutes with the CEO of ElevenLabs, now reportedly valued at $22B
items.summary: ElevenLabs powers the AI voice on the other end of a lot of customer service calls, and its CEO told me this week that businesses should probably tell you that — at least until getting a machine is what everyone expects anyway.

items.title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
